decision: The long-lived CEP GitHub Writer repository is the self-contained execution-input plane for ALL CEP Writer types and equivalent mission Auditors/Reviewers. Broad repository archaeology, repo-wide recursive search, generic grep/rg/find, or instructions such as 'inspect anything useful' are prohibited by default because they waste model context and can import stale/unrelated authority. A BOUNDED_DISCOVERY_ESCAPE is allowed only for a named missing, contradictory, or insufficient mission input and must stay within the smallest relevant directory/source family and record why it was needed. `main` must carry the current Controller-bound Product baseline plus every reusable/current Writer-readable input a competent worker needs: build/test tooling, contracts/profiles, current governed visual references, applicable domain/oracle/technical references, Writer-relevant Owner-decision snapshots, protected-truth/acceptance rules, workflow guidance, and genuinely required deterministic fixtures/reference datasets. A mission branch/workspace inherits those inputs and adds only the exact immutable mission overlay plus task-specific inputs not already present. Required reference images/PDFs/fixtures are INPUTS and remain available even when relatively large; do not remove them merely to minimize repository size. Writer execution must not depend on live Google Drive lookup for required task inputs. The Controller must retrieve/resolve any Drive-only authority/evidence/profile/oracle input before launch and embed or deterministically project the sufficient authoritative content into the repository, mission overlay, capsule, or bound workspace with provenance/hash/classification. CHATGPT_WRITER may possess a Drive connector, but required mission inputs are still pre-resolved and self-contained; live Drive is for Controller authority reconstruction, bounded explicitly-authorized retrieval, and output custody—not worker-side broad archaeology. GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_WRITER and ROUTE-LOCAL workers must not be instructed to read required inputs directly from Drive. ROUTE-LOCAL additionally uses the already materialized governed local repository/worktree as its execution source: do not clone/pull/fetch from GitHub at the start of every mission. Bind the exact local repository path/branch/HEAD/tree and continue from it; clone/fetch/pull occurs only when the Owner/Controller explicitly authorizes a transport synchronization because the required checkpoint is absent/stale or a carrier transition requires it. Google Drive remains canonical for live Controller state/governance and heavy GENERATED OUTPUT custody such as candidate/evidence/baseline ZIPs, large screenshot sets, videos and generated reports. Small handoff/results/receipts may bind external Drive outputs by file ID, SHA-256, bytes and source/commit identity. Before launch, Controller must prove MISSION REQUIRED INPUT SET -> EXACT PATH/SECTION RESOLUTION -> HASH/CLASSIFICATION MATCH -> CONTEXT-SUFFICIENT CLOSED READ SET -> NO REQUIRED DRIVE-ONLY DEPENDENCY -> WRITER_SELF_CONTAINMENT_PASS. If any required input is missing/stale/unresolved, launch stops as WRITER_INPUT_INCOMPLETE.
notes: Owner explicitly required the former local-only prompt/read-set extension to be merged into this same durable decision instead of remaining a separate active OD. OD-20260925-084 is preserved only as superseded lineage. The generalized law applies to all Writer types; route-specific facts remain scoped: Local and Google AI Studio do not directly consume required Drive inputs, and Local normally continues from its existing governed local repository rather than cloning/pulling every mission.

Connector/tool limits are transport constraints, never a reason to spend the Writer's main effort on packaging, split uploads or repeated custody operations, and never a reason to change Product architecture. Prefer reference decomposition/cropping -> current capture -> region/state comparison -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture -> compare -> repeat, with final evidence promotion only after the Writer has used the loop to improve the Product.
